intro.text: A construction foreman in Lossand, working under Kelzi Karmat.

items.text: When scaffolding gave way, Kenton held up a roof so some of Trell's crew could escape. Fearing a sand master's anger would fall on his men, Trell humbly took the blame, but Kenton won his trust and told him to send the crew home to their families for the day, which he gladly did.

appearance.text: Bald, in a Lossandin labourer's dull, loose clothes and leather boots.

personality.text: Selfless and devoted to his workers; he treats Kenton with great respect.
